name: United Kingdom

languages.note: Skilled Worker applicants new to the route from 2026-01-08 must prove English at CEFR B2 (was B1). India is not an exempt majority-English country, so a SELT or an English-taught degree confirmed by Ecctis is needed.

salary.note: Levels.fyi all-levels TOTAL compensation, 4,723 data points: 25th £61,733, median £92,414, 75th £133,081, 90th £181,179; London median £109,633. Range = median→90th as rough senior proxy; base pay outside London and at non-big-tech firms is markedly lower. Immigration going rate for SOC 2134 is £54,700 (official minimum, not market rate).

income_tax_note: Progressive income tax plus National Insurance; Scotland has different bands. Rates not re-verified in this session.
cost_of_living_note: London much more expensive than other cities. Applicant also pays the Immigration Health Surcharge (amount not read).

visa_routes.name: Skilled Worker visa

salary_threshold.note: Must be paid the HIGHER of £41,700 or the occupation going rate. SOC 2134 Programmers and software development professionals: £54,700 (£28.05/h, 37.5h week); 2133 IT business analysts/architects: £54,900; 2139 IT n.e.c.: £52,300; 2135 Cyber security: £48,500; 2136 IT quality and testing: £41,200. Lower rates (e.g. £33,400 tradeable points, new entrants) exist but rarely help a senior hire.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: No degree required for the visa; the JOB must be at the higher-skilled level (RQF 6 occupations since 2025-07-22) and on the eligible occupation list.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: Degree not required for eligibility, so a 3-year BCA is not a barrier. A degree taught in English can be used to meet the B2 English requirement if Ecctis confirms it; otherwise take an approved SELT. A relevant PhD gives salary points (not applicable to a BCA).
visa_routes.lottery_or_quota: No cap or lottery; depends on finding a licensed sponsor.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: Currently Indefinite Leave to Remain after 5 years. Announced 2026-11-02 'earned settlement' reform: 10-year default, 5 years if earning over £50,271, 3 years if earning £125,141+ for 3 years; rules and start date pending and expected to apply to people already in the UK.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: Employer needs a sponsor licence and pays the Immigration Skills Charge: £1,320 per year for medium/large sponsors (£660 per extra 6 months; max £6,600 for 5 years) or £480/year for small/charitable sponsors, plus certificate of sponsorship fee (amount not read).

visa_routes.name: Global Talent visa (digital technology)
visa_routes.degree_requirement: No degree requirement; needs endorsement as a leader/potential leader in digital technology (criteria not researched this session).
visa_routes.path_to_pr: Announced earned-settlement plan keeps a 3-year pathway for eligible Global Talent holders (subject to final rules).
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: No employer; applicant pays endorsement + visa fees.

sponsor_register.name: Register of licensed sponsors: workers (Home Office / UKVI)
sponsor_register.update_frequency: Most working days (latest file 2026-11-19, ~10.4 MB); no schedule stated.
sponsor_register.how_to_use: Scrape the publication page for the current CSV link (filename changes each update, e.g. SP_-_Worker_and_Temporary_Worker_Web_Register_-_2026-11-19.csv). Keep rows whose Route is 'Skilled Worker' (also 'Global Business Mobility: Senior or Specialist Worker'), and whose rating is A. Normalise organisation names (lowercase, strip Ltd/Limited/PLC/LLP/UK, punctuation, 't/a' trading-as splits) and fuzzy-match against the job's company; also match on town for disambiguation. Being on the register means the company CAN sponsor, not that the specific job will.

ease_for_indian_nationals.rationale: No degree requirement and no lottery, and there is a large public sponsor register that is updated almost daily. Against that, salary must reach £54,700 for software developers, the English requirement rose to B2 in January 2026, employer costs and sponsor compliance put some firms off, and settlement is moving from 5 to a default 10 years (5 for earners over £50,271).

factors.degree_recognition: Not required for Skilled Worker; 3-year degree fine.
factors.language_barrier: None, but proof of B2 English is required (SELT or Ecctis-confirmed English-taught degree).
factors.employer_willingness: Many tech firms hold licences; many postings still require existing right to work.
factors.attestation_or_paperwork: CoS from sponsor, English evidence, TB test certificate for India residents (not verified this session), IHS payment.

relocation_norms: Not researched from a citable source in this session; some sponsors pay visa costs/relocation, others recoup via clawback clauses (note: the Immigration Skills Charge itself may not be passed to the worker – not re-verified).

scam_warnings: Agents selling Certificates of Sponsorship or 'guaranteed sponsored jobs' for a fee; CoS sales led to many sponsor-licence revocations. Check the company on the official register and Companies House.
Companies recently added to the register with no trading history, offering jobs unrelated to their business.
Requests for the worker to pay the Immigration Skills Charge or sponsor-licence costs (employer cost).
Fake 'UKVI' calls or emails demanding payment; UKVI does not take payments by phone.
